rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling pleased or honoured about an achievement or fact.

example.english: I'm really proud to see you win the championship.
example.traditional: 見到你攞到冠軍，我真係好自豪。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 nei5 lo2 dou2 gun3 gwan1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 zi6 hou4

rows.note: Use this when “proud” means having an overly high opinion of oneself.

example.english: He's so proud, he thinks he knows everything.
example.traditional: 佢咁自大，成日以為自己乜都識。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 zi6 daai6 seng4 jat6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 mat1 dou1 sik1

rows.note: Use this when someone is too concerned with saving face to do something such as apologise.

example.english: He's too proud to apologize even when he does something wrong.
example.traditional: 佢死要面，做錯事都唔肯道歉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sei2 jiu3 min6 zou6 co3 si6 dou1 m4 hang2 dou6 hip3

rows.note: Use this for something that gives people a reason to feel proud, such as a proud day or achievement.

example.english: This achievement is truly something to be proud of.
example.traditional: 呢個成績真係令人自豪。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sing4 zik1 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 zi6 hou4
